verdict.rationale: Polar exposes payout and balance data via documented API endpoints (finance/payouts.md, finance/balance.md) and offers a versioned OpenAPI spec plus an official remote MCP server that agents can connect to for querying organization data including orders/customers, which supports an AI-native reconciliation workflow. However, there is no documentation or example specifically showing linking a payout to the underlying set of charges/orders that compose it (e.g., a payout-to-transactions/balance-transaction line-item endpoint), which is the core of 'reconciliation' as described. missing for 10: explicit balance-transaction/payout line-item API or docs showing charge-to-payout mapping, a worked reconciliation example or agent workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation of MCP agent performing this reconciliation task.
